name: Turnersuchus
sum: Turnersuchus is the oldest diagnostic and most basal known thalattosuchian, from the Early Jurassic of the United Kingdom.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; on display at the Lyme Regis Museum since 2023.
material: The holotype from the Charmouth Mudstone Formation, discovered by Paul Turner and prepared by Elizabeth Hingley, who also found additional material.
biology: The sources consulted describe its anatomy and basal position but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Wilberg et al. 2023

sources.text: Wilberg, E. W.; Godoy, P. L.; Griffiths, E. F.; Turner, A. H.; Benson, R. B. J. 2023.
